name: booking-confirmation
title: Booking Confirmation
summary: Bind the patient's approval to one exact booking payload, submit it once, and describe the outcome by its lifecycle state rather than by the transport response.
when_to_use: The workflow is in AWAITING_FINAL_APPROVAL and the patient is being asked to approve a booking
The workflow is in BOOKING_IN_FLIGHT and the approved booking request is being submitted
A booking response arrived and its state must be described to the patient
A booking-relevant field changed after approval was granted and the consent must be re-established

inputs.name: booking_payload
inputs.description: patient_id, provider_id, hospital_id, slot_id, visit_type, document_ids, contact_phone. The exact object being approved.

inputs.name: workflow_id
inputs.description: The workflow the consent belongs to.

inputs.name: state_version
inputs.description: The version the workflow is at when consent is taken; moving past it supersedes the approval.

inputs.name: approval
inputs.description: Existing consent with payload_hash, state_version, expires_at and consumed.

inputs.name: readiness
inputs.description: Must be satisfied for the same hospital, plan and visit type.

inputs.name: slot
inputs.description: The slot being booked, with its status and optimistic-concurrency version.

outputs.name: booking_request
outputs.description: The submitted request with its BookingState, idempotency key and evidence.

outputs.name: patient_message
outputs.description: A description that matches the lifecycle state exactly; REQUESTED and PENDING_REVIEW are never called confirmed.

outputs.name: decision
outputs.description: Reason code is ok, approval_expired, approval_payload_changed, no_slot_available, policy_blocked or booking_outcome_unknown.

references.purpose: Which changes invalidate an approval, the invalidated_reason each maps to, and how each BookingState may be described.
